title: One Leader at a Time — Schedia
description: Viewstamped Replication told in the Tholos of Schedia: five legislators, one law, a podium only its holder may write from, and a new holder who starts from the fullest copy a majority can show.
question: Many systems put one leader in charge at a time. When the leader falls silent, how does another take over without losing anything the last one promised?
how: We find out by exploring how Schedia, a Greek city on Paxos with laws of its own, kept its law from a podium that one legislator held at a time, and how a new holder took over when the last one fell silent.

papers.authors: Brian M. Oki and Barbara H. Liskov
papers.title: Viewstamped Replication: A New Primary Copy Method to Support Highly-Available Distributed Systems
